about: The NextZXOS Browser navigation, one copy for every driver: tools/machines/next/browser-drive (drive.py, suite.py, collection.py,
real time over the WebAPI), tools/machines/next/regress/regress.py (frame-counted over the WebAPI) and NexBrowserRun_Test
(core/tests/loaders/nex/nexbrowser_test.cpp, frame-counted in the core). Described in testdata/machines/zxnext/README.md.
A step: key (a key name of the keyboard queue, POST /keyboard/tap) or combo (keys held together, POST /keyboard/combo), held
for hold frames, then after frames run; idle: then run in steps of step frames until NextZXOS waits for a key (at most frames),
plus settle frames. frames alone: run that many frames. seconds: what a real-time driver waits instead (with idle: sleeps that
long, then polls for the idle loop; without: only sleeps).

idle.about: NextZXOS waits for a key: the CPU halted in the ROM key-wait loop (BASIC programs wait there too)

listing.about: The Browser's order: '.' and '..' (subdirectories only: a FAT root has none), then the names case-insensitively

search.about: An entry is found by the search (H): the shortest prefix of the name's searchable part that only one entry of the listing starts with (case-insensitively). A name whose searchable part has no unique prefix, or starts with another character, is reached by counting down from the top

boot.about: power on / reset to the welcome page, which waits for a key

menu.about: SPACE: past the welcome page to the main menu

browser.about: B: the main menu's Browser (it opens in the directory it was last in)

type.about: the search text (POST /keyboard/type, delay frames between the characters); frame drivers run frames_per_char per character plus after

accept.about: ENTER: accept the search, the cursor stays on the match

down.about: cursor down one entry (the count-down way)

open.about: ENTER on a directory: the Browser shows it

run.about: Running the entry under the cursor, by the file's extension; '*' is every other extension (.nex, .snx, .bas)

sna.about: the first run of a snapshot shows the Snapshot Loader's options page (To begin loading, press ENTER)

tap.about: SYMBOL SHIFT + ENTER: the TAP loader's options (a plain ENTER starts a tape run once in its remembered mode)
the TAP loader's mode: N = Next / +3 (1 128K, 0 USR0, 4 48K, P Pentagon); S before it steps the play speed

basic_run.about: The Browser only LOADS a .bas saved without an autostart line: the NextBASIC editor shows the listing (its black status bar at the bottom, no black header bar on top). Then the text is typed (type step's delay) and the step pressed
